title: feat: approved minor onboarding via claim link
body:
## Summary

- Adds `verified_minor` boolean + timestamp columns to users table
- New `POST /api/admin/create-minor-account` endpoint (service-token auth): generates keypair, creates user with `verified_minor=true`, claims username on divine-name-server (best-effort), generates 14-day claim token
- Extends `GET/PUT /api/admin/users/:pubkey/status` to return `verified_minor` and `verified_minor_at` fields
- Idempotent retry: re-calling with the same username returns 200 with existing/refreshed claim token
- Race condition safe: concurrent creates for the same username produce correct idempotent or conflict responses (not a confusing 400)

**API contract note:** `UserStatusResponse` (GET/PUT `/api/admin/users/:pubkey/status`) now includes `verified_minor: bool` and `verified_minor_at: Option<String>`. These are additive fields — existing JSON consumers that ignore unknown fields are unaffected.

Relates to divinevideo/support-trust-safety#148
Part of divinevideo/support-trust-safety#138

Companion PR in divine-relay-manager (divinevideo/divine-relay-manager#90) depends on this being deployed first.

## Test plan

- [ ] Migration runs cleanly on staging (`verified_minor` column added, existing users default to `false`)
- [ ] `POST /api/admin/create-minor-account` with valid username returns `{ pubkey, claim_url, expires_at }`
- [ ] Duplicate username returns 409
- [ ] Invalid username format (special chars, leading hyphen) returns 400
- [ ] `GET /api/admin/users/:pubkey/status` includes `verified_minor: true` for created account
- [ ] Claim link resolves to the claim page and allows email/password setup
- [ ] divine-name-server shows NIP-05 for the created username

## Integration tests (9 tests)

1. Happy path — 201 with claim URL
2. Idempotent retry — same username returns 200 with valid claim token
3. Conflict — username taken by non-minor user (409)
4. Conflict — username taken by claimed minor with email set (409)
5. Conflict — username taken by Vine preloaded user, unclaimed non-minor (409)
6. Invalid username rejected (empty, spaces, leading hyphen → 400)
7. Missing auth token (401)
8. Wrong auth token (401)
9. Retry with expired token creates new token (200, different claim URL)

## Local verification

- [x] Migration runs cleanly (`verified_minor` boolean + `verified_minor_at` timestamptz added to users table)
- [x] Existing users default to `verified_minor=false` (confirmed via `GET /status` on a standard registered user)
- [x] `POST /api/admin/create-minor-account` with valid username returns `{ pubkey, claim_url, expires_at }` with 14-day TTL
- [x] Duplicate username returns 409 with descriptive error
- [x] Invalid username format (leading hyphen) returns 400 with validation message
- [x] Missing/wrong auth token returns 401
- [x] `display_name` optional param works correctly
- [x] `GET /api/admin/users/:pubkey/status` returns `verified_minor: true` and `verified_minor_at` for minor accounts
- [x] `GET /api/admin/users/:pubkey/status` returns `verified_minor: false` (no `verified_minor_at`) for normal accounts
- [x] DB records confirm `verified_minor=true` and `verified_minor_at` set on created users
- [x] `cargo check` and `cargo fmt` pass
- [x] Race condition fix verified: `RepositoryError::Duplicate` caught and retried idempotently

title: feat: add batch-lookup endpoint for HubSpot contact enrichment
body:
## Summary

- Adds `POST /api/admin/users/batch-lookup` — service-token authenticated endpoint that accepts up to 1000 emails and returns user data (pubkey, status, email_verified, has_personal_key, created_at) keyed by email
- Server-side email dedup and case-insensitive matching, uses existing `(tenant_id, email)` index
- 11 integration tests covering happy path, auth gates, validation, edge cases (dedup, case sensitivity, suspended users, personal key accuracy)

Enables divine-invite-sync to enrich HubSpot contacts with Divine account data for marketing segmentation.

Relates to divinevideo/support-trust-safety#149

## Test plan

- [x] 11 integration tests pass (`cargo test --test batch_lookup_test --features integration-tests`)
- [x] Full workspace test suite passes (no regressions)
- [x] Verified locally with curl against running dev server — mixed found/not_found, wrong token, missing token, empty array, case-insensitive + dedup all confirmed
